title: Dow Jones Futures Rise As Dell, NetApp Surge On Earnings; Oil Falls On U.S.-Iran Deal Hopes
title_zh: 戴尔、NetApp 盈利飙升，道琼斯期货上涨；美国与伊朗达成协议希望油价下跌
summary: The stock market rose to fresh highs Thursday on a reported interim U.S.-Iran deal. Dell soared overnight on earnings.
summary_zh: 据报道，美国与伊朗达成临时协议，周四股市升至新高。戴尔的盈利隔夜飙升。

title: Oil falls, stocks hit records on U.S.-Iran ceasefire deal
title_zh: 美伊停火协议推动油价下跌、股市创历史新高
summary: Brent crude is on pace for its biggest monthly drop since March 2020 as Wall Street cheers a 60-day truce with Tehran
summary_zh: 华尔街欢呼与德黑兰达成 60 天休战协议，布伦特原油有望录得 2020 年 3 月以来最大单月跌幅

title: Equity Futures Rise Amid US-Iran Deal Optimism
title_zh: 美伊协议乐观，股指期货上涨
summary: US equity markets were pointing higher before the opening bell Friday, while oil prices fell as trad
summary_zh: 美国股市周五开盘前走高，而油价则因传统交易而下跌

title: Thursday Recap: Stocks Hit Record as Investors Cling to Hope of U.S.-Iran Deal
title_zh: 周四回顾：投资者对美伊协议抱有希望，股市创下新高
summary: Stocks rose on reports that Iran and the U.S. had reached a preliminary deal. Meanwhile, Snowflake stock surged after the cloud-software company reported strong earnings and struck a $6 billion deal with Amazon.
summary_zh: 有报道称伊朗和美国已达成初步协议，股市上涨。与此同时，在云软件公司 Snowflake 公布强劲盈利并与亚马逊达成 60 亿美元交易后，该公司股价飙升。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Pull Back After Trump Wants 'Couple Days To Think' About Iran Ceasefire Deal: ASTS, DELL, BB, SMCI In Focus
title_zh: 特朗普希望“几天时间考虑”伊朗停火协议后，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货回调：ASTS、DELL、BB、SMCI 成为焦点
summary: According to a report from Axios, the U.S. and Iran have reached a tentative deal to extend the ceasefire between the two nations by 60 days and are on track to discuss Tehran’s nuclear program.
summary_zh: 据Axios报道，美国和伊朗已达成初步协议，将两国停火期限延长60天，并有望讨论德黑兰的核计划。
